discipline: Arts (external component; no standalone CCMAS Portuguese package)

enrichment_basis.note: Portuguese is an explicitly named facet of the JAMB Portuguese/English offering. The NUC Arts CCMAS package supplies the English facet; this component is an external Nigerian reference curriculum from OAU's official Portuguese/English Combined Honours handbook. It is not presented as LASU's exact course schedule.

sources.institution: Obafemi Awolowo University, Department of Foreign Languages
sources.role: primary external Nigerian reference curriculum for the named Portuguese facet
sources.locator: Printed pp. 60-62 (combined-programme structure) and pp. 75-79 (Portuguese course contents).

courses.title: Audio-Visual Course in Portuguese I
courses.content_summary: Beginner Portuguese through audio-visual instruction, covering basic sound patterns, vocabulary, sentence patterns and the four language competences.
skills_learned: Recognise and produce basic Portuguese sounds and sentence patterns.
Use beginner Portuguese vocabulary and the four basic language competences.

courses.title: Portuguese Conversation and Laboratory Work
courses.content_summary: Spoken Portuguese practice and language-laboratory work designed to build listening and speaking automatism.
skills_learned: Participate in basic Portuguese conversations.
Use laboratory practice to improve listening and spoken fluency.

courses.title: Elementary Portuguese Grammar and Comprehension
courses.content_summary: Elementary Portuguese grammar and comprehension with guided oral and written work.
skills_learned: Apply elementary Portuguese grammar.
Understand short Portuguese oral and written passages.

courses.title: Audio-Visual Course in Portuguese II
courses.content_summary: Continuation of the beginner audio-visual Portuguese course, extending vocabulary, grammar and the four language competences.
skills_learned: Extend beginner Portuguese vocabulary and sentence control.
Use listening, speaking, reading and writing practice at the next beginner level.

courses.title: Portuguese Grammar
courses.content_summary: Portuguese grammar study. The handbook table contains a title typo, while the course-content section identifies the course as Portuguese Grammar.
skills_learned: Explain and apply the Portuguese grammar structures covered in the course.
courses.source_locator: Printed p. 62 course table and printed p. 75 course-content section; course-content section used to resolve the table-title typo.

courses.title: Introduction to Portuguese Composition
courses.content_summary: Short Portuguese compositions, punctuation, formal text conventions and logical ordering of ideas.
skills_learned: Write short, logically ordered Portuguese compositions.
Use Portuguese punctuation and formal text conventions.

courses.title: Portuguese Comprehension II
courses.content_summary: Continuation of elementary Portuguese comprehension with progressively more demanding oral and written passages.
skills_learned: Understand longer Portuguese passages.
Respond to Portuguese comprehension tasks in speech and writing.

courses.title: Advanced Portuguese Composition
courses.content_summary: Advanced Portuguese composition and controlled written expression.
skills_learned: Write coherent Portuguese compositions at an advanced level.
Revise written Portuguese for structure and accuracy.

courses.title: Contemporary Short Stories in Portuguese
courses.content_summary: Reading and study of contemporary Portuguese short stories.
skills_learned: Read contemporary short stories in Portuguese.
Discuss literary language, themes and structure in selected stories.

courses.title: Introduction to Portuguese Language Study
courses.content_summary: Introduction to Portuguese language study, including phonology, morphology, semantics and suprasegmental features.
skills_learned: Analyse basic Portuguese phonology, morphology and semantics.
Identify suprasegmental features in Portuguese speech.

courses.title: Advanced Portuguese Comprehension
courses.content_summary: Advanced comprehension and paraphrase of complex Portuguese texts.
skills_learned: Interpret complex Portuguese texts.
Paraphrase Portuguese texts accurately and clearly.

courses.title: Translation: Portuguese into English
courses.content_summary: Theory and practice of translating Portuguese texts into English.
skills_learned: Translate Portuguese texts into clear English.
Apply basic translation principles when resolving meaning and register.

courses.title: Advanced Portuguese Grammar
courses.content_summary: Advanced Portuguese grammar and controlled language use.
skills_learned: Analyse and use advanced Portuguese grammar structures.
Edit Portuguese text for grammatical accuracy.

courses.title: History of Brazilian Literature
courses.content_summary: Historical study of Brazilian literature and its major periods and writers.
skills_learned: Describe major periods and developments in Brazilian literature.
Interpret selected Brazilian literary works in historical context.

courses.title: Romantic Literature in Brazil
courses.content_summary: Study of Romantic literature in Brazil and its cultural and literary context.
skills_learned: Identify features of Brazilian Romantic literature.
Interpret selected Romantic texts in their historical context.

courses.title: Trabalho Pratico
courses.content_summary: Practical Portuguese work involving guided use of the language in discussion, presentation or laboratory activities.
skills_learned: Use Portuguese in guided practical activities.
Present and discuss selected topics in Portuguese.

courses.title: Literary History of Portugal since Camões
courses.content_summary: Literary history of Portugal from Camões onward.
skills_learned: Explain major periods in Portuguese literary history since Camões.
Relate selected Portuguese works to their literary-historical context.

courses.title: Advanced Translation: Portuguese into English
courses.content_summary: Advanced translation and interpretation from Portuguese into English.
skills_learned: Translate complex Portuguese texts into English.
Interpret meaning, register and context in advanced Portuguese-to-English work.

courses.title: Contemporary Afro-Brazilian Literature
courses.content_summary: Study of contemporary Afro-Brazilian literature and its cultural contexts.
skills_learned: Interpret selected contemporary Afro-Brazilian literary works.
Discuss literary representation and cultural context in the works studied.

courses.title: Portuguese Dissertation and Oral
courses.content_summary: Independent Portuguese research dissertation and oral presentation.
skills_learned: Plan and complete a Portuguese-focused research project.
Present and defend the project orally in an academic setting.

courses.title: Advanced Translation: English into Portuguese
courses.content_summary: Advanced translation and interpretation from English into Portuguese.
skills_learned: Translate complex English texts into Portuguese.
Interpret meaning, register and context in advanced English-to-Portuguese work.

courses.title: Applied Portuguese Linguistics
courses.content_summary: Applied Portuguese linguistics with attention to language use and a Nigerian context.
skills_learned: Apply linguistic concepts to Portuguese language use.
Analyse Portuguese language questions in an applied Nigerian context.
